urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)
param = (k, d) => urlParams.get(k) ?? d
setParam = (k, v) => { try { const u = new URL(window.location.href); if (v == null || v === "") u.searchParams.delete(k); else u.searchParams.set(k, v); history.replaceState(null, "", u); } catch (e) {} }
f2 = x => x == null || !isFinite(x) ? "–" : d3.format(".2f")(x)
f3 = x => x == null || !isFinite(x) ? "–" : d3.format(".3f")(x)
f0 = x => x == null || !isFinite(x) ? "–" : d3.format(",.0f")(x)
pct = x => x == null || !isFinite(x) ? "–" : d3.format(".0%")(x)
pct1 = x => x == null || !isFinite(x) ? "–" : d3.format(".1%")(x)
usd = x => x == null || !isFinite(x) ? "–" : d3.format("$,.0f")(x)

// tile map: data = [{st, v}], returns an SVG element whose .value is the clicked state; calls onPick(st)
tileMap = (data, {color, fmt = f2, selected = null, onPick = null, w = 640, title = ""} = {}) => {
  const byst = new Map(data.map(d => [d.st, d.v]));
  const cs = Math.min(52, (w - 10) / 12), H = cs * 8 + 10;
  const svg = d3.create("svg").attr("width", cs * 12 + 4).attr("height", H).attr("viewBox", [0, 0, cs * 12 + 4, H]).style("max-width", "100%").style("font-family", "inherit");
  const g = svg.selectAll("g").data(Object.entries(TILES)).join("g").attr("transform", ([s, [x, y]]) => `translate(${x * cs + 2},${y * cs + 2})`).style("cursor", onPick ? "pointer" : "default");
  g.append("rect").attr("width", cs - 3).attr("height", cs - 3).attr("rx", 4)
    .attr("fill", ([s]) => byst.has(s) && byst.get(s) != null && isFinite(byst.get(s)) ? color(byst.get(s)) : "#e6e9ec")
    .attr("stroke", ([s]) => s === selected ? INK : "none").attr("stroke-width", 2.5);
  const lum = c => { const r = d3.rgb(c); return 0.299 * r.r + 0.587 * r.g + 0.114 * r.b; };
  const tc = ([s]) => byst.has(s) && byst.get(s) != null && isFinite(byst.get(s)) && lum(color(byst.get(s))) < 140 ? "white" : INK;
  g.append("text").attr("x", (cs - 3) / 2).attr("y", cs * 0.4).attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", cs * 0.27).attr("font-weight", 700).attr("fill", tc).text(([s]) => s);
  g.append("text").attr("x", (cs - 3) / 2).attr("y", cs * 0.72).attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", cs * 0.21).attr("fill", tc).text(([s]) => byst.has(s) ? fmt(byst.get(s)) : "");
  g.append("title").text(([s]) => `${STNAME[s]}: ${byst.has(s) ? fmt(byst.get(s)) : "n/a"}`);
  if (onPick) g.on("click", (e, [s]) => onPick(s));
  return svg.node();
}
// weighted least squares slope/intercept
wls = (pts, x, y, wt) => { const W = d3.sum(pts, wt), mx = d3.sum(pts, d => wt(d) * x(d)) / W, my = d3.sum(pts, d => wt(d) * y(d)) / W;
  const b = d3.sum(pts, d => wt(d) * (x(d) - mx) * (y(d) - my)) / d3.sum(pts, d => wt(d) * (x(d) - mx) ** 2);
  const ss = d3.sum(pts, d => wt(d) * (y(d) - my) ** 2), sr = d3.sum(pts, d => wt(d) * (y(d) - my - b * (x(d) - mx)) ** 2);
  return {b, a: my - b * mx, r2: 1 - sr / ss}; }
